_comment: Camera capability catalog. Loaded by AppFactory to resolve model-specific behavior without putting hardware knowledge into adapter code. Add new models here as support is added.

CSI.name: RPIcam v3 Wide NoIR
CSI.setup_notes: No special boot configuration required. camera_auto_detect=1 (default) works.

CSI.name: RPIcam v3 Wide
CSI.setup_notes: No special boot configuration required. camera_auto_detect=1 (default) works.

CSI.name: RPIcam v3
CSI.setup_notes: No special boot configuration required. camera_auto_detect=1 (default) works.

CSI.name: RPIcam Lens
CSI.setup_notes: HQ Camera (C/CS-mount). No electronic focus motor — AfMode/LensPosition are skipped automatically. If not detected: set camera_auto_detect=0 and add dtoverlay=imx477 in /boot/firmware/config.txt, then reboot.

CSI.name: RPIcam v2
CSI.setup_notes: Fixed-focus camera. AfMode and LensPosition controls are not available.

CSI.name: RPIcam v1.3
CSI.setup_notes: Fixed-focus camera. AfMode and LensPosition controls are not available.

USB.name: Logitech HD 1080p
USB.setup_notes: Logitech HD 1080p (C270/B910/similar). V4L2 driver may ignore requests below 1080p and use native sensor resolution instead. Use 1920×1080 or 2304×1536 to avoid silent rounding.

USB.name: Logitech C920
USB.setup_notes: USB UVC camera. Handled by UsbCameraAdapter.

USB.name: Genérica USB / Webcam
USB.setup_notes: Cámara USB genérica. Handled by UsbCameraAdapter. Si la resolución solicitada no está en el firmware, V4L2 la redondea silenciosamente. Usar resoluciones nativas del sensor.
